changelog:
**Dragging a programme finally shows you where it will land - and it was never the dragging that was broken.** Driven end to end, every drop always produced its change; it was invisible. The day column cleared the drop line whenever the pointer left it, and a `dragleave` also fires when the pointer crosses into a *child* - and a day column is full of children, one per programme. So the line was wiped as fast as it was drawn, and with no line, no snap label and the browser's default refusal cursor, the whole gesture reads as doing nothing at all. That is one bug behind three separate reports: drag and drop not working, dragging from the shelf not working, and snapping being absent.

**The selection ring has a bottom edge again.** It looked exactly as though the next programme was painting over it. It was not - the ring is drawn inside the bar, and the bar's own one-pixel gap strip is a child of it, so each bar was covering its own bottom edge. The gap stays, because bars that touch read as one block; it is simply the colour of the ring now.

**Deleting with the keyboard lands on the next programme** rather than on nothing, so taking a run of them off is press, press, press instead of press, hunt, click, press.

**"Plugins LiteTV leans on" is back**, under Ask YouTube as in Server settings. It was on the old configuration page and was lost when the page became an app - the server went on answering and nothing asked it. It is worth having because these plugins fail *quietly*: a channel still airs without Smart Similar, the suggestions are merely blunter, and nothing anywhere says so. Three states rather than two - answering, installed but silent, and absent - because installed and silent is the one worth drawing, since it looks like working. Every one of them now says what it is for; two were listed with no description at all.

The rest: the Content screen counted films, series and collections but **not playlists**, so a channel of a playlist and a series called itself "1 series" and a channel of nothing but playlists summarised itself as an empty space, with its sources listed underneath saying otherwise. And with no blocks on a channel, "No blocks - the whole week plays the list above" was printed twice, once with the button beside it and once without.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
